Radiology Service
Antoni van Leeuwenhoek
15 Feb 2025 | Multiparametric MRI Prostate

Indication: Assessment of previously diagnosed prostate malignancy. Presenting PSA stands at 9.3 ng/mL. History notes an earlier PI-RADS 5 finding.

FINDINGS:
Prostatic volume registers at 18.03 mL. T2-weighted sequences reveal a 14-mm hypointense focus within the right mid-gland transition zone. High b-value DWI highlights pronounced diffusion restriction, while dynamic contrast-enhanced imaging captures early, localized enhancement. Extracapsular spread and seminal vesicle involvement are absent. Neurovascular bundles remain preserved. Lymph nodes and bone marrow show no suspicious changes.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 5 lesion in the right mid-prostate.
Prostate volume 18.03 mL; PSA density 0.516 ng/mL/mL.
csPCa predicted probability 0.85247576.

previous_notes.text: 02 Sep 2023 - Dr. F. de Boer (GP): Initial referral triggered by a routine screening PSA of 9.9 ng/mL. Digital rectal examination yielded normal findings. previous_notes.text: 29 Feb 2024 - Dr. F. de Boer (GP): Urology correspondence verified the earlier biopsy result showing ISUP grade group 3 disease. Latest PSA values have plateaued near 8.6 ng/mL. The patient remains under specialist observation for continued assessment.
